# Streamlit MMI: Inline learn/mmi Docs

Date: 2026-01-07

## Summary
- Added an in-app documentation viewer to the Streamlit MMI demo so users can browse the learn/mmi pages directly in the UI.

## Files Modified
- `examples/14_mmi_streamlit.py`
  - Added `_load_doc()` helper to read markdown from `docs/learn/mmi/` (overview, physics, design, numerics, usage, validation).
  - Added a “Documentation (learn/mmi)” section with a selectbox to render the chosen markdown in-page.

## Notes
- Rendering uses `st.markdown`; if a file is missing, a warning message is shown.
- No runtime tests run (UI-only addition).
